name: JVM Memory Used
description: jvm_memory_bytes_used vs jvm_memory_bytes_max{area=heap}, by broker instance.
programText:
data('jvm_memory_bytes_used', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='Used')
data('jvm_memory_bytes_max', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker') and filter('area', 'heap')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='Max Heap')
